key_catalyst: Escalating U.S.-Iran conflict driving an oil surge and higher Treasury yields
reasoning: The U.S.-Iran conflict has escalated into a 12th day of strikes, diplomacy is described as stalled, and oil has moved above $90 while Treasury yields approach two-month highs—an unresolved inflation and valuation shock for QQQ. This is a material escalation beyond the prior oil-risk narrative rather than routine noise. The July 21 risk rally relied on falling yields and chip strength, both of which are reversing ahead of pivotal Alphabet and Tesla results.
